entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say your order number or the reason for your call.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. I see your order number, can I get your full name please?
Mark Cole. Look, I don't have a lot of time. I need to return the cycling shoes from this order. Yes or no, can I do it?
I can certainly help you with that, Mr. Cole. Just to make sure I'm documenting this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?
They're causing terrible blisters on my heels. I've tried adjusting the cleats, different socks, everything. They just don't work for my feet. I want a refund.

I understand completely, getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me check the purchase date... Okay, I see you received them 29 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window.
Good. So you'll process the full refund?

Absolutely. I've just authorized the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you right now. Just pack the shoes in the box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed.
And Mr. Cole, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble with the blisters, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for your next purchase. We appreciate your business.
Oh. A credit. Okay, that's good. Thank you, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
